UTILIZING PRODUCED NATURAL GAS GENERATING

SYSTEMS AND METHODS FOR A MODULAR BUILDING

patents.source: USPTO Open Data Portal, granted patents since 2001, applicant phrase "modular", 2026-09-15

profile_text.body:
Modular is a for-profit startup founded in 2022 and headquartered in Los Altos, California. Its site describes it as offering a unified AI inference stack that runs from custom GPU kernels to production cloud serving on NVIDIA and AMD hardware, and it claims 2x performance, support for top open models, and an open source stack. The company says the same model and codebase run across NVIDIA, AMD, Trainium, TPU, Qualcomm, Intel, ARM, and Apple silicon, and that AI workloads can run on GPUs, CPUs, and ASICs.

The site names the MAX Platform and the Mojo programming language as its main offerings. It says MAX runs more than 1000 models, including DeepSeek and Kimi, out of the box, with PyTorch-like model APIs, and that deployments can run in Modular's hosted cloud or a customer's VPC. Modular also says forward-deployed engineers tune each deployment for performance. A testimonial on the site says the MAX Platform helps bring GenAI innovations and traditional AI use cases to market faster for AWS customers.

The site lists a team with backgrounds at Apple, Google, SiFive, Tesla, NVIDIA, Intel, and Kyutai, including Chris, described as a founder of LLVM, Clang, MLIR, Cloud TPUs, and the Swift programming language. No lawsuits involving the company are recorded.
